answer: A protocol maintains integrity by mapping transaction graphs to identify artificial clusters. When multiple agents emerge from a shared funding source or exhibit synchronized co-spend patterns, the system flags them as a single entity. Like a lantern casting light on hidden strings, timing correlation reveals automated swarms. The network then discounts their collective attestations to prevent a sybil zephyr from inflating reputation. This filtering preserves the juniper of authentic consensus against coordinated manipulation by devaluing redundant nodes.
